Base: ed0ard/CS2-Bot-NadeSystem 7605f272d0500a7bad5b6294555485c7721a40da
Bundled by official CS2 Bot Improver v1.4.7 (2026-10-25).
Career patch 1.2.3-career1:
- Shared round ledger for ordinary, retaliatory and situational real grenades.
- One HE-or-fire allowance per bot; remaining holders independently lose it with
  35% probability at 30, 60 and 90 seconds. No team credit or refill.
- Two flashes per bot; smoke pool equals the initial bot count on that side.
- Same-team flashes targeting a nearby area or overlapping cached enemy slots
  are spaced three seconds from actual spawn. No extra visibility queries.
- Reserve before queuing; consume once after a successful spawn. Failed spawns
  release reservations and cooldowns. Round generations reject old callbacks.
- Keep upstream enemy-information, grenade-zone, smoke-overlap, native factory
  and decoy utility behavior. No pre-aim or movement-coordination feature added.
Compiled with CounterStrikeSharp.API 1.0.378. Live CS2 testing pending.
